definition.concept: Single orchestrating capsule containing multiple specialized sub-capsules
definition.purpose: Hierarchical state coordination for multi-stage pipelines (encoders, transports, etc)

key-difference.vs: Single-purpose primitive (DCT, Quantization); flat no hierarchy

definition.core-principle: Impossible states prevented via lockfree coordination of embedded sub-capsules

architecture.pattern: Single 256B-1024B orchestrating capsule with 4-18 embedded sub-capsules
architecture.coordination-mechanism: DualAtomicU64 (primary + secondary) with phase bitmasks for hierarchical FSM
architecture.lockfree-guarantee: 100% atomic operations; zero mutex/RwLock; O(<50ns) state transitions

when-to-use.use-case: Multi-stage pipeline (3+ independent stages) with deterministic ordering
State machine complexity (8+ states, transitions impossible to violate)
Real-time constraints (<100ms latency SLA, no GC pauses)
Tier composition needed (T6 Mixed orchestrating T1-T5 sub-capsules)
when-to-use.anti-pattern: Simple sequential processing → Use T5 Streaming Pipeline instead
Embedded systems <512B total memory → Use Component Capsules (flat)
Loose coupling between stages → Use message-passing, not metacapsule

metacapsule.use: Multi-stage orchestration: codecs, transports, state machines

component-capsule.use: Single-purpose primitive: DCT, quantization, hash, filter

metacapsule-advantages.advantage: Lockfree snapshot: Single atomic read captures entire orchestrator state (~50ns)
Chaos compliance: 100% atomic, zero mutex/RwLock, nested sub-capsules allowed
Deterministic latency: <100ns state transitions via Acquire/Release ordering (SWeMR)
Cache efficiency: 256B-1024B aligned prevents false sharing; sub-capsules co-located
Type safety: Impossible states prevented at compile time (#[derive(ComputationalCapsule)])
Hierarchical testing: T28 validates full FSM; sub-capsules tested independently

example.name: Av1EncoderMetacapsule
example.sub-capsules: 18 (EncoderState, FrameBuffer, DCT, Quantization, Entropy, Tile, etc)

example.name: QuicEndpointMetacapsule
example.sub-capsules: 22 (QuicConnection, Stream, Packet, Crypto, Flow, ACK, Congestion, etc)

example.name: UniversalApiMetaCapsule
example.sub-capsules: 6 implicit (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, JSON-RPC, SSE)

best-practices.practice: Keep orchestrator ≤1024B: Larger → split into component capsules
Sub-capsule dependency graph acyclic: Impossible deadlock (encode→compress→output)
Atomic snapshot before state transition: Prevents partial state exposure
Phase bitmasks for FSM: Each sub-capsule owns bits; no field conflicts
Test sub-capsules independently PLUS integration: T28 4-tier validation
Generation counters on DualAtomicU64: TOCTOU detection between snapshot + write

topology.description: Linear chain of sub-capsules, data flows one direction

topology.latency: O(1) for direct, O(hops) for indirect

states.state: Sub-capsules being constructed in dependency order
All sub-capsules initialized, ready to accept work
Active work in progress, sub-capsules executing
Completing in-flight work, rejecting new submissions

implementation-notes.note: All transitions use CAS on primary AtomicU64 with generation bump
State encoded in bits 0-7 of primary field (8 states = 3 bits, reserved to 8)
Snapshot state before transition to ensure atomic visibility
Failed state requires full reconstruction (new() call)

protocol.description: Sub-capsules execute in strict order, each waits for previous
protocol.use-case: Dependent transformations where output of A is input to B
protocol.implementation: Phase counter increments; each stage checks counter matches its turn
Each sub-capsule owns generation counter; orchestrator waits for all
protocol.example: Tile processing: Tile0 || Tile1 || Tile2 || Tile3

protocol.description: Overlapped execution with bounded queues between stages
protocol.latency: Latency of slowest stage (after N-stage warmup)
protocol.implementation: Ring buffers between stages; producer/consumer coordination
protocol.example: Video: Frame[n] decode || Frame[n-1] transform || Frame[n-2] output

protocol.description: Execute ahead optimistically, rollback on mispredict
protocol.latency: Best case: O(1); Worst case: O(n) + rollback
protocol.implementation: Snapshot state before speculative execution; restore on mispredict
protocol.example: Optimistic MVCC: execute assuming no conflicts, rollback if detected

inter-tier-rules.rule: T1→T2: Direct or Pipeline (Atomic feeds SIMD vectorization)
T2→T3: Pipeline (SIMD output to fixed-point accumulation)
T6→*: Any (metacapsule can orchestrate all connection types)

connection-summary.detailed-spec: See xml/capsule-connections.xml for full API definitions

guideline.rule: Total metacapsule ≤1024B (fits in L1 cache line set)
Prefer fewer larger sub-capsules over many tiny ones
Use DualAtomicU64 for 2+ independent state dimensions
Phase bitmasks: Allocate 4-8 bits per major sub-capsule group
Generation counter in high 32 bits for TOCTOU detection
Sub-capsule failures propagate to metacapsule error state
Log error context before state transition for debugging
T28 Q1-Q7: Unit test each sub-capsule independently
T28 Q8-Q14: Property test state machine transitions
T28 Q15-Q21: Integration test full metacapsule workflows
T28 Q22-Q28: Production stress test with realistic load
T28 Q29-Q35: Determinism test for reproducible behavior

anti-pattern.name: Shared mutable state between sub-capsules
anti-pattern.solution: Each sub-capsule owns its state; communicate via connections

anti-pattern.name: Cyclic dependencies between sub-capsules
anti-pattern.solution: Enforce acyclic dependency graph at design time

anti-pattern.name: Unbounded queues between pipeline stages
anti-pattern.solution: Use bounded ring buffers with backpressure

anti-pattern.name: Fine-grained sub-capsules (<64B each)
anti-pattern.solution: Merge related logic into larger sub-capsules

anti-pattern.name: Ignoring sub-capsule initialization order
anti-pattern.solution: Topological sort of dependency graph in init()
